'''Starboard''' was one of two [[Uvak]] used to steer the [[Airship/Legends|airship]] [[Candra (ship)|''Candra'']]. It was berthed on the right side of the airship, whereas [[Port (uvak)|Port]] was berthed on the left. When the ''Candra'' was destroyed, Starboard's body fell through the sky almost crushed [[Jogan Halder]], was it not for [[Quarra Thayn]] getting a feeling through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="pandemonium" />
